description:
Log an action transition between two visual states or log a visual blocker (action_type: click, type, navigate, scroll, custom, blocker). Call this after every UI interaction to update transition statistics and success rates. When action_type is "blocker", generates a structured visual blocker payload for state-memory-mcp instead of recording a transition (from_state_id becomes the visual_state_id of the blocker). Use record_outcome instead of predict_next_action when persisting actual interaction results rather than predicting recommended next steps.

Returns transition record, updated edge weights, or state-memory blocker payload.

action.description: Action description (or blocker description when action_type is "blocker")

action_type.description: Category of UI action. Use "blocker" to create a visual blocker payload.

from_state_id.description: Source state ID (or blocker visual_state_id when action_type is "blocker")

project.description: state-memory-mcp project name (only used when action_type is "blocker")

success.description: Whether action succeeded (default: true, ignored for blockers)

to_state_id.description: Destination state ID (not required when action_type is "blocker")

name: record_outcome
